Townhome for rent - 88 Birch Lane, San Carlos, CA
Rent: $2,295 a month. Deposit $2,295 (OAC). 
Pets: Cats and small dogs only, 30 lb maximum. Larger dogs considered case by case with owner approval. Pet fee $400 non-refundable. Pet rent $50/mo.
Utilities: water, sewer, trash billed back via RUBS. Tenant pays electric and gas. 3 bed 2.5 bath, 1,450 sqft. 1 car garage.
Application fee $50 per applicant 18+. Admin fee $150. Broker fee one half month.
Move-in special: Months 1-2 half off.
